actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Adobe Experience Manager (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Adobe Experience Manager action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Adobe Experience Manager connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: copy_folder_asset
actions.title: Copy folder/asset
actions.description: Copy folder or asset in Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Copies a folder or asset in Adobe Experience Manager. When copying a folder, you may also copy its children. Note: If using on-prem instance of AEM, this action requires OPA version 2.20.0 or greater to work.

input.name: path
input.label: Parent folder
input.hint: Select the folder to copy. Only the first 100 folder/assets are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found.

input.name: destination_path
input.label: Destination folder
input.hint: Select the folder/asset to copy. Only the first 200 folder/assets are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found or if you want to copy this to a new folder.

input.name: destination_name
input.label: Destination name
input.hint: To rename a folder, provide a new folder name. Example: new_folder . To rename an asset, provide a new asset name along with file extension. Example: Sample.txt . If both folder and asset name have in…

input.name: depth
input.label: Copy contents as well?
input.hint: Select Yes to copy all contents of the folder. No to copy only the selected asset or folder.

input.name: overwrite
input.label: Overwrite asset in destination
input.hint: Select Yes to overwrite assets at the destination folder. No if the destination folder does not exist.

actions.name: create_folder
actions.title: Create folder
actions.description: Create folder in Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Creates a folder in Adobe Experience Manager. This creates an Ordered Folder in Adobe Experience Manager DAM.

input.name: path
input.label: Parent folder
input.hint: Select the folder to watch. Only the first 200 folders are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found.

input.name: name
input.label: Folder name
input.hint: The internal name of the folder. Folder name also can contain special characters. For example, new_folder@test .

input.name: title
input.label: Folder title
input.hint: The title of the folder.

actions.name: delete_folder_asset
actions.title: Delete folder/asset
actions.description: Delete folder or asset in Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Deletes a folder or asset in Adobe Experience Manager. You may also delete specific renditions of an asset.

input.name: path
input.label: Folder/Asset path
input.hint: Select the folder/asset to delete. Only the first 200 folder/assets are shown. Enter path manually if your folder cannot be found.

actions.name: download_asset
actions.title: Download asset
actions.description: Download asset in Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Downloads an asset in Adobe Experience Manager. Provide the path to the asset. Assets could be anything from images to files stored in your AEM DAM.

input.name: path
input.label: Path
input.hint: Select the folder to watch. Only the first 200 folders are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found.

actions.help: Moves a folder or asset in Adobe Experience Manager. When moving a folder, you may also move its children. Note: If using on-prem instance of AEM, this action requires OPA agent version 2.20.0 or greater to work.

input.name: destination_path

input.hint: Select the folder/asset to move. Only the first 200 folder/assets are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found.

input.name: destination_name
input.label: Destination name
input.hint: To rename a folder, provide a new folder name. Example: new_folder . To rename an asset, provide a new asset name along with file extension. Example: Sample.txt . If both folder and asset name have in…

input.name: overwrite
input.label: Overwrite asset in destination
input.hint: Select Yes to overwrite assets at the destination folder. No if the destination folder does not exist.

actions.name: search_assets
actions.title: Search assets
actions.description: Search assets in Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Search for assets in Adobe Experience Manager. First, select the folder in which to search or provide the path to the folder. Then provide the search parameter.

input.name: path
input.label: Path
input.hint: Select the folder to watch. Only the first 200 folders are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found.

input.name: include_subfolders
input.label: Include subfolders
input.hint: If yes , new assets added to subfolders within the selected folder will be returned.

input.name: search
input.label: Property search
input.hint: Provide any of the properties to filter by. For example, jcr:content/dam:assetState . Learn how to use this.

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Number of records to skip.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Number of records to fetch.

input.name: nodedepth
input.label: Nodedepth
input.hint: Often not configured. Allows you to control the amount of data fetched about each Asset. We default to retrieving all data. 1 indicates just the Assets basic data and increasing the value of the numbe…

input.name: asset_output_fields
input.label: Asset output fields
input.hint: We provide default asset output fields. If you require more fields, use this to override the defaults. Learn how to use this.

actions.name: update_asset_metadata

actions.description: Updates asset metadata in Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Updates an assets metadata in Adobe Experience Manager.

input.name: path
input.label: Asset Path
input.hint: Select the folder or asset to update. Only the first 200 folders/assets are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found or if you want to move this to a new folder.

input.name: properties

input.hint: First provide the name of the metadata property to update. Then give the value that it should be updated to. Nested metadata properties can travelled to via / . For example, key will be like metadata/…

actions.name: upload_asset

input.name: path
input.label: Path
input.hint: Select the folder to watch. Only the first 200 folders are shown. Enter file path manually if your folder cannot be found.

input.name: name
input.label: File name
input.hint: The name of the asset.

input.name: file_content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: The file contents.

input.name: content_type
input.label: Content type
input.hint: For example: image/png .

actions.name: upload_asset_streaming
actions.title: Upload asset by streaming
actions.description: Streaming upload asset into Adobe Experience Manager
actions.help: Upload an asset by streaming in Adobe Experience Manager. Please note that this action is only applicable for Cloud instances. Note: If the asset uploaded does not support streaming, the file size is restricted to 100Mb on Adobe Experience Manager.

input.name: path
input.label: Path
input.hint: Select the desired folder for the upload. If you can't find your folder in the list, opt to manually enter the path. This is because only the first 200 folders are displayed in the list.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: Provide the name of the asset.

input.name: file_content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Provide the contents of the file.

input.name: file_size
input.label: File size (in bytes)
input.hint: The file size of the asset being uploaded in bytes.

input.name: handle_duplication
input.label: Duplicate asset data handling
